name: slide_period
title: Slide relative to an index chunked by period

origin.description: slide_period() breaks up the .i-ndex by .period, and then uses that to define the indices to slide over .x with.

arguments.name: .x
arguments.text: The vector to iterate over and apply .f to.

arguments.name: .i
arguments.text: A datetime index to break into periods. It must match .x in size, be increasing, and contain no missing values.

arguments.name: .period
arguments.text: A string defining the period to group by, passed to warp::warp_distance().

arguments.name: .f
arguments.text: A function applied to each window.

arguments.name: .every
arguments.text: The number of periods to group together.

arguments.name: .before / .after
arguments.text: How many period steps to include before or after the current one. Inf selects all periods on that side.

arguments.name: .complete
arguments.text: When TRUE, partial windows at the ends are dropped and replaced with missing placeholders.

origin.details: The underlying engine for breaking up .i is warp::warp_distance(). Windows are built with hop_index_common() on the period groups.
origin.value: A list with one element per unique warp_distance value on .i.

translation.description: Slides a callable over x using warp period groups on datelike index i.
translation.usage: slide_period(x, i, period, f, *args, every=1, origin=None, before=0, after=0, complete=False)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A vector, NumPy array, column dict, or warp Date / POSIXct / POSIXlt.

arguments.name: i
arguments.text: A warp Date, POSIXct, or POSIXlt index with the same length as x.

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Called on each window slice of x.

arguments.name: before / after
arguments.text: Period steps before or after the current group; math.inf is unbounded.

arguments.name: complete
arguments.text: Trim partial windows and pad with None like R NULL placeholders.

translation.details: Calls warp.warp_distance, forms hop ranges on unique groups, and applies hop_index_apply like slide_period_common in R.
translation.value: A list of window results, one per unique period group.
translation.example:
from slider.slide_period import slide_period
from warp import Date
slide_period([1, 2, 3, 4], i2, "month", lambda w: w, before=1)
